name: List
description: Readable rows for named things such as jobs, assets, runs, and DAGs.

source.description: Resource binding that supplies the rows

item.description: Row fields that fill the title, description, badge, meta, icon, and status

rowLink.description: Link each row to a route

rowActions.description: Actions with `variant: "primary"` and an icon appear as row buttons. The rest open from the overflow menu.

searchable.description: Add a search box that matches the title, description, badge, and meta

noun.description: Singular noun for the count and the search placeholder, such as `"job"`

filters.description: Filter dropdowns, each bound to a row field

pageSize.description: Rows shown before a "Show more" button. All rows when omitted.

emptyMessage.description: Text shown when there are no rows
